'''Phelar''' was a [[city]] located on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[Planet|world]] of [[Eriadu]].<ref name="TK" /> During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], [[Eris Harro]], [[HNN Bureau Chief|Bureau Chief]] of the [[HoloNet News]] [[Outer Rim Node]], held office in Phelar.<ref name="IPC Pin">[[HoloNet News promotional pin]]</ref> The city also housed an Imperial [[Junior Academy]]. Under the strict laws of [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], supporters of Tarkin defended the man's policies as ways to remain tough on crime, justifying that belief by saying the streets of Phelar were safer.<ref name="TK" />
